prompts.featured: Use case: stylized-concept. Original MEE editorial illustration, a handcrafted miniature set with tactile matte ceramic, paper and limestone textures, sophisticated contemporary art direction, soft directional studio light and long gentle shadows. Palette warm ivory #F7F6F2, vivid ultramarine #1547BB, small vermilion #EF383E accents, charcoal #15171B. A single coherent scene, no collage. Wide landscape composition, main objects safely inside the central 80 percent for cropping. No letters, words, logos, watermarks, banknotes, charts or flags. This is conceptual illustration, not documentary evidence. Cover illustration for a self-study quiz on market economics. Close tabletop still life of an open ivory notebook with ten empty square checkboxes arranged as two neat columns of five, no words beside them, blue pencil diagonally across the lower page, a very small freestanding red eight-point star beside the notebook. Sculptural paper texture and beautiful raking light, landscape crop.
